source: Community analysis, trailer evidence, and cross-generation data extrapolation

predictions.title: Release Window
predictions.basis: Rockstar's official '2025' announcement, since pushed. Trailer II timing and typical Rockstar marketing cycles suggest late 2025 or early 2026.

predictions.title: Launch Price
predictions.basis: CPI inflation from GTA V's $59.99 (2013) projects ~$78–82 in 2025 dollars. PS5/XS standard pricing is already $69–79 across major titles.

predictions.title: Map Size
predictions.basis: Trailer I shows Miami-scale urban density plus visible Everglades-style wetlands. GTA V was 75 km²; 2× expansion is consistent with the SA → V jump. High uncertainty.

predictions.title: Vehicles at Launch
predictions.basis: GTA V launched with ~260 vehicles, grew to 737+ via GTA Online DLC. Extrapolating the GTA Online expansion rate and Rockstar's stated ambition yields ~1,000 at or shortly after VI launch.
